diagnostic_limitations: The saved evaluator distinguishes verified-prefix and invalid parsed transitions and reports repetition. It does not separately classify reversals versus other unproductive branches; those are retained in raw generations and the invalid-transition count rather than inferred post hoc.
distractor_answer_sensitivity: exclude arithmetic items whose explicitly irrelevant marker count equals the reference answer; descriptive sensitivity only
matched_accuracy_rule: lowest frozen C4 budget whose pooled per-generation accuracy is at least the comparator frontier point; reduction uses pooled median reasoning tokens

primary_hypothesis_families.central_frontier: C4 greater than C0, C1, and C2 at budgets 64 and 128
primary_hypothesis_families.h5_structured_vs_telegraphic: C4/R3 greater accuracy than C3/R2 under the same reasoning-token cap at budgets 64 and 128
primary_hypothesis_families.multiplicity_scope: one Holm family containing all eight tests

primary_test: one-sided paired sign randomization, C4 greater
reliable_depth_rule: greatest frozen controlled depth with pooled per-generation accuracy at least 0.800
verified_density_zero_control_rule: When control density is zero, positive treatment density is an extended infinite rate ratio and passes any finite minimum ratio; both zero is undefined and fails. JSON numeric ratio is null in either boundary case.
within_item_reduction: arithmetic mean across the three paired training/decoding blocks
